downloads.label: Downloads (store installs)
downloads.note: Downloads count store installs, not people. Reinstalls and several devices per person mean the drop-off is an estimate. Platform slices can overlap; the total deduplicates signups.

signinFunnel.source: Client action events; validated server OAuth starts and callbacks override client reports; authenticated signed-in events exclude internal installs and classify new-account Signup completions.
signinFunnel.note: Stages count distinct installs within the window, not a joined person cohort. Signup counts installs whose account was created during that same provider attempt; returning-account sign-ins do not count as Signup. Retries and different providers can overlap. Collection begins with this release; earlier dates are unmeasured.
